stemMd:
The engineer described the new frame as lighter than ______ while still able to support the same load. The comparison helped the team evaluate whether the redesign justified its higher cost.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.label: C
options.textMd: the weight of the previous frame

explanationMd: The comparison should place like entities on both sides: the new frame is lighter than the previous frame. Comparing the frame itself with a weight is logically mismatched.

distractorRationale.a: An adverb cannot serve as the comparable object in this construction.
distractorRationale.d: This creates an ill-formed comparison of the stated property.
distractorRationale.c: This compares a frame with a weight rather than with another frame.
